context.why: Story 1 is accepted: Contribution.level, RecordAccess (fairdm/contrib/contributors/access.py), Crediting (services/crediting.py) with add, update(roles) and remove, and the tab's list, portal add, edit-roles and remove pages are rebuilt and tested (tests/test_contrib/test_contributors/test_access.py, test_services/test_crediting.py, test_plugins/test_shared.py with its conftest). This story rebuilds the organization a person is credited from on a record. The prototype already draws it and the maintainer approved it: the choice is the Cotton component cotton/contribution/affiliation.html (radio buttons named `affiliation` with values `org:<pk>`, `other`, `none`, and a text input `affiliation_name`), fed by ContributionPage.affiliation_choice and read by read_affiliation and credit_from in plugins/shared.py. That Python is untested prototype code. Move the rule into Crediting, put the choice behind a form field group, and test it. The ORCID and by-hand ways of adding a person also end on this choice; US3 rebuilds those ways, so here make the choice work and be tested for a person chosen from the portal and on the edit page, and keep the prototype's registry and by-hand ways working with it, untested.
spec_sections: Edge Cases (an organization deleted from the portal; the organization typed is not in the portal)
plan_sections: D3 (add with organization, update with organization, remove's credited_from refusal, credited_from())
prior_decisions: decisions.md D6: delete the model hook Contribution.set_default_affiliation (fairdm/contrib/contributors/models.py). A person added with no organization is stored with none. The person's primary affiliation is only the option selected to begin with on the page. Find every caller that relied on the hook (Contribution.add_to, Contributor.add_to, record.add_contributor, seeds, factories, existing tests) and decide for each: a pre-existing test that asserted the hook's behaviour describes behaviour this feature replaces, so update it in T009 and name it in progress.md.
decisions.md D8 to D12 were written by story 1; read D8, D11 and D12. Page tests go in tests/test_contrib/test_contributors/test_plugins/test_shared.py (D12), not a new module.

Crediting.add becomes add(contributor, *, organization=None) and update becomes update(contribution, *, roles, organization=<unchanged sentinel or explicit>): design the signature so that 'leave it alone', 'set to this organization' and 'set to none' are three different things. The level argument on update is US4's; leave level writing where story 1 left it (D8).

An organization a person is credited from is listed on the record, once, as its own contribution (so it has a place in the order and can carry roles). It stays when the last person credited from it leaves or is credited from elsewhere, and can then be removed (the maintainer approved this). Removing an organization that anyone on the record is credited from is refused with ValidationError code `credited_from`, and the people are available to the page so it can name them.
Contribution.affiliation changes from on_delete=PROTECT to SET_NULL: write the migration with makemigrations, apply it to the dev database (see environment).
An organization typed by name that is not in the portal is made as a new Organization with that name (FR-023). An empty name with 'other' chosen is refused on the field.

plan D10: c-contributor.item (templates/cotton/contributor/item.html) and c-contributor.card.person (templates/cotton/contributor/card/person.html) fall back to the person's primary organization when given a contribution with no affiliation. Remove the fallback for a contribution only; given a Person they behave as before. These are shared components from an earlier feature: change only that expression. The tab's templates currently pass secondary="none" to work around the fallback; once the component is right you may leave those attributes or drop them, but the page must draw the same. T008's tests go in tests/test_contrib/test_contributors/test_components.py if the conformance step accepts a module that mirrors templates; if it refuses, put them where the existing tests of these components live and note it.
decisions.md D7: a superuser is refused by Crediting.add with a ValidationError; unchanged here.

The dev database's seeded example records carry affiliations set by the prototype's seed (demo/seed/contributors.py affiliate()). Have the seed set them through Crediting. Do not rerun seed_contributors without --keep-records against the dev database.

acceptance.given_when_then: Given a record, when a person is added or updated with an organization, with none, or an organization people are credited from is removed, then the outcomes in tasks.md T006 hold and the refusal carries code credited_from and the people.

Given User Story 2's scenarios, when the portal add page and the edit page are used through the test client, then the choice offers the person's affiliations with the primary selected, another organization and none; the tab shows what was chosen and keeps showing it after the profile changes; and an organization people are credited from offers no removal and refuses a direct request, naming them.
Given a contribution with no organization, when the two shared components draw it, then no organization is shown; given a person, the primary organization is shown as before.
Given the failing tests from T006 to T008, when the implementation lands, then all pass, the SET_NULL migration exists, the hook is gone and makemigrations --check is clean for first-party apps.

Given the user guide page from story 1 and CONTEXT.md, when read against the branch, then they say how the organization is chosen, why it does not follow the profile, and that a contribution carries it.
